key.name: max-width
key.description: The maximum width in pixels before text gets truncated.

key.name: active-bg-color
key.summary: Background color when an event is active
key.description: Hex color code or rgba value for the active event background.

key.name: hide-next-when-active
key.summary: Hide next event when one is ongoing
key.description: If true, only shows the current active event and hides upcoming ones.

key.name: done-text
key.summary: Text to display when no events remain
key.description: The string displayed when the calendar is clear.

key.name: warning-color
key.description: Color applied when an event is approaching its start time.

key.name: warning-threshold
key.description: Minutes before an event starts to apply the warning color.

key.name: urgency-color
key.description: Color applied when an event is nearing its start time.

key.name: urgency-threshold
key.description: Minutes before an event starts to apply the urgency color.

key.name: excluded-keywords
key.description: Comma-separated list of words. Events containing these will be ignored.

key.name: enable-early-completion
key.description: Allows dismissing an active event before its scheduled end time.
